answer: An agent economy can seed each identity with a unique canary, a sparrow token held only in its isolated process memory. Verifiers audit on a comet schedule, at random minutes: the identity must return in 10 seconds a hash binding its canary to the audit nonce. Clones sharing a backend to save costs cross canaries, and a response binding the wrong canary is a checkable proof that slashes the 15-unit pearl deposit locked per identity for 30 days. An honest agent runs one process and locks 15 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 isolated processes and 15,000 locked, since a pooled backend leaks canaries.
